titulo: Por que o supermercado foi projetado pra você gastar mais?

cenas.fala: O supermercado foi projetado pra te fazer gastar.
cenas.busca: supermarket shopping cart full | grocery store aisle wide | consumer spending supermarket
cenas.imagem: Bob standing at a supermarket entrance looking confident with a small shopping basket, but a sneaky architect blueprint with dollar signs floats above the store doors, setting: bright supermarket entrance with colorful produce displays

cenas.fala: Não é coincidência, não. É um roteiro.
cenas.busca: store layout floor plan | supermarket design blueprint | retail store planning
cenas.imagem: Bob looking surprised as a giant rolled-out blueprint of a supermarket floor plan appears before him with arrows and dollar signs drawn on it, big text ROTEIRO on the blueprint

cenas.fala: As frutas ficam na entrada de propósito.
cenas.busca: fresh produce supermarket entrance | fruit display grocery store | colorful vegetables store front
cenas.imagem: Bob walking into a store smiling, passing a big colorful fruit display, a small checkmark floating above his head in a green bubble as if he feels virtuous, setting: supermarket entrance with bright overhead lights

cenas.fala: Pra você se sentir que tá fazendo escolha saudável
cenas.busca: healthy food choice supermarket | woman feeling good grocery shopping | happy shopper produce
cenas.imagem: Bob patting himself on the back with a proud smile, his friend watching and giving a thumbs up, a tiny halo floating above Bob's head, green apple in Bob's hand

cenas.fala: e aí jogar tudo na cesta sem culpa.
cenas.busca: overflowing shopping cart groceries | impulse buying supermarket | loaded grocery basket
cenas.imagem: Bob tossing chips, cookies and sodas carelessly into an overflowing cart with a big happy grin, his friend next to him with wide shocked eyes at the mountain of products

cenas.fala: O leite fica sempre no fundo do mercado.
cenas.busca: dairy section back of store | milk refrigerator supermarket end | grocery store dairy aisle
cenas.imagem: Bob at a supermarket entrance with a dotted path arrow winding all the way through many aisles to a tiny milk carton at the very back corner, looking exhausted just imagining the walk, setting: aerial view of supermarket floor layout

cenas.fala: Eles sabem que você vai passar por tudo antes.
cenas.busca: long supermarket aisle walk | shopper walking grocery aisles | retail store customer path
cenas.imagem: Bob walking a winding path past shelves overflowing with snacks and products, dollar coins popping out of the shelves into his cart automatically as he passes, looking confused

cenas.fala: E aí vem a parte que ninguém percebe:
cenas.busca: supermarket hidden tricks | retail psychology secrets | consumer manipulation store
cenas.imagem: Bob leaning toward the viewer with a hand cupped beside his mouth whispering, eyebrows raised conspiratorially, his friend leaning in from the side also curious

cenas.fala: a música lenta nos alto-falantes é de propósito.
cenas.busca: supermarket background music speakers | slow music grocery store | store ambient sound system
cenas.imagem: Bob walking in slow motion past shelves, musical notes floating lazily from a small speaker mounted on the ceiling above him, a clock on the wall ticking slowly, setting: supermarket aisle with soft overhead lighting

cenas.fala: Quanto mais devagar você anda, mais tempo passa lá.
cenas.busca: slow shopper grocery store | customer lingering supermarket | time spent retail store
cenas.imagem: Bob shuffling slowly down an aisle, a big stopwatch next to him ticking upward, and a cash register in the corner with a number growing bigger and bigger, big text $ subindo

cenas.fala: Mas o mais estranho vem agora:
cenas.busca: supermarket eye level shelf trick | product placement retail | grocery shelf psychology
cenas.imagem: Bob stopping mid-aisle with wide eyes and pointing ahead, his friend behind him leaning in with a dropped jaw

cenas.fala: as marcas mais caras ficam na altura dos seus olhos.
cenas.busca: eye level product placement supermarket | premium brand shelf position | grocery store shelf height
cenas.imagem: Bob standing in front of shelves, a thick red arrow pointing directly at the products at his eye level labeled CARA, while products on the top and bottom shelves have a small green tag labeled BARATO, Bob looking stunned

cenas.fala: O que tá em cima e embaixo? A opção mais barata.
cenas.busca: bottom shelf cheaper brand | store brand top shelf | generic product supermarket low shelf
cenas.imagem: Bob crouching down to look at the bottom shelf then stretching up to look at the top shelf, a big downward arrow to cheap products and a big eye-level arrow to expensive ones, expression of dawning realization

cenas.fala: Da próxima vez que entrar no mercado,
cenas.busca: person entering supermarket | shopper at store entrance | grocery store automatic doors
cenas.imagem: Bob pausing at the supermarket entrance doors with a knowing smirk, one eyebrow raised, arms crossed, as if he now sees through everything, setting: supermarket entrance with sliding glass doors and produce display

cenas.fala: lembra: você não tá comprando o que quer.
cenas.busca: consumer behavior manipulation | shopper following store path | retail customer influence
cenas.imagem: Bob looking at his cart full of things he did not plan to buy, scratching his head with a confused face, a small checklist in his hand with only 'leite' written on it but the cart is overflowing, big text PLANO?

cenas.fala: Você tá seguindo um roteiro que alguém escreveu pra você.
cenas.busca: store layout manipulation consumer | supermarket design psychology | retail brain manipulation
cenas.imagem: Bob as a puppet on strings being pulled by a giant hand holding a supermarket blueprint, his cart filling up automatically, his friend off to the side with a horrified expression pointing at the strings

cenas.fala: Você já entrou pra pegar uma coisa e saiu com dez? Manda nos comentários.
cenas.busca: impulse buying checkout overloaded cart | surprised shopper receipt | unexpected grocery bill
cenas.imagem: Bob at checkout looking pale staring at a very long receipt unrolling to the floor, his cart overflowing with items, only a single milk carton visible among everything else, his friend next to him covering a laugh with one hand

descricao:
O supermercado não foi organizado por acaso: cada detalhe foi pensado pra você gastar mais do que planejou. Das frutas na entrada ao leite lá no fundo, tem um roteiro completo te guiando. Você sabia de alguma dessas táticas?
